components.title: RideTube (fork by 7amoody1985)
components.description: A modified build of JustAnotherPU's RideTube (github.com/JustAnotherPU/ridetube), not endorsed by its developer. Fixes the Search menu (and the settings in it) closing right after it opens. Needs the RideTube service jap-ridetube-d from the JustAnotherPU/ridetube source. Source: github.com/7amoody1985/ridetube
components.author: JustAnotherPU, modified by 7amoody1985

components.title: CarLink (experimental)
components.description: Experimental. The next turn from HudHud or Google Maps on your phone, in the middle of the instrument cluster and as a home-screen widget, sent by the CarLink phone app over the car's Wi-Fi. Demo shows it without the phone. Needs cluster-render from the robertnisipeanu/idrive-apps source.
components.author: 7amoody1985
